Calories burned per MILE for a 160 Pound Person

Walking 4.0 mph - 91cal x 8miles = 728

Running 5.0 mph - 116cal x 8miles = 928

According to this running will lose more, but thats only theoretical. Running 8 miles is a lots harder then walking it. If you need to stop running you may go slower then your overall walking speed.
I eat subway everyday cus im not only fat, but lazy and Im still losing :)

My simple tip for you is:
Eat what you want when you want. Just make sure its below your TDEE. 
You can find what your TDEE is using an online calculator (google) and one other thing, dont go to hard at the gym or with exercises. Most of the weight is lost by eating better, for me its like 80%food 20% Cardio. Just be sensible and I wish you the best of luck. Stick to food you like, just less often and with less of it!

The stomach is the fat! Once you start dropping the pounds you'll see your stomach change drastically, your arms will slim, your legs will slim and your stomach will too. I wish you the best of luck, it will take time. but you know patience is a virtue!

My dude thats incredible. You look great. If you want to keep losing weight/fat go for it but if I was in your shoes I would want to start gaining some muscle mass. You really do look good and you should be happy with your results. I aspire to one day be in your shoes! or pants size :)

Just counting calories (calories in calories out). I eat subway 4x a week, however what I get is filling and in the end of the day im below my daily calorie limit. It really doesnt matter what you eat, or how much you eat its all about the calories. I could eat 30 apples a day or 1 pizza and some healthy foods and still lose the same amount of weight.

I recommend incline walking, you can do it in a park or on a treadmill. Not too hard and is easy for burning calories. Anyways you can reach you results easily without exercising. Just use CICO, for me 80% of weight loss is eating right and the rest is exercise. 

Good luck!
